scope: registration only; future literal-field adapter checks, no hash draws or world execution

assembly_expansion.map_reuse: one per-law map shared by all eight slots and four initial field records

field_source_contract.interface: callback(initial_id, field, index, modulus) -> raw integer; no proposal ID or hash fallback
field_source_contract.map_reads: child_kind_by_donor at initial=0, indices 0,1,2, modulus=3, exactly once each per assembly; returns registry map minus one
field_source_contract.rule_reads: initial=0, rule-slot index 0..7, declared field domain; unused fields may be skipped
field_source_contract.initial_reads: requested initial ID, node_kind/node_state indices 0..7 modulus=3; structural indices 0..7 modulus=2; scheduler index=0 modulus=18446744073709551615
field_source_contract.validation: reject missing required keys, non-integers including booleans, and out-of-range returned values before modulo reduction; no fallback draws

comparison.rules: exact complete decoded JSON equality Rust/Python; separately check literal variant shape and all operation operands/order/costs against v2 contract with only the three declared kind substitutions
comparison.assembly: exact complete environment equality, eight slot IDs, map routing trace, law identity across four initial IDs; original Contact ring, literal initial fields, resources, counters, ledgers and limits
comparison.ignored_fields: base rule uses map [2,3,1], kind0=0, kind1=2, new_kind=0, state0=state1=3, value=2, sign=0, amount=0, matter=1, rule_id=0; change only the listed field across listed values; exact output unchanged in both adapters
comparison.barriers: evaluate only registered local predicates on descriptors; no matching or dynamics; expected flags do not assert operation applicability or full reachability
comparison.invalid_inputs: each adapter must reject every named invalid case with a structured error and no output environment; all other fields use the ignored-field base, initial=0 and first literal initial record
comparison.coverage_limits: finite authored boundary panel, not all field combinations, finite sampler preimages, sampled-law equivalence, or native reachability

gate: every fixed rule and assembly cell present exactly once in order; complete Rust/Python equality and independent operation/accounting invariants
all routing/map reuse checks, six ignored-field groups, eight barrier verdicts and twelve input rejections pass
no hash sampler, candidate enumeration, transition interpreter, worker, detector or historical campaign invocation; retain identities/logs of every readiness attempt
all historical frozen sources and receipts unchanged; source/binary/input hashes and full counts recorded

future_validation_limits.note: development readiness limits, not a campaign or benchmark; build and ordinary unit tests precede validation; validator must enforce limits and retain truncation/failure receipts

failure_policy: retain failed readiness attempts; fix implementation and repeat the same fixed panel with new source identities/output directory. Do not edit frozen inputs or criteria to turn a failure into a pass. This engineering panel is not a consumed scientific sampling experiment.
implementation_admission_after_registrat: only separate literal-field adapters and their fixed readiness validator; no hash sampler implementation or execution
